title: Egg Production Consistency by Henhouse
dataSources: Beehive weight and entrance activity (`beehive:weight`), hive climate (`beehive:climate`), brooder climate (`brooder:climate`), egg counts (`coop:egg`), rain-barrel level (`rainbarrel:level`), greenhouse climate (`greenhouse:climate`), orchard bloom observations (`orchard:bloom`), and milking logs (`milking:session`).
app: Homestead telemetry from beehive monitors, coop sensors, brooder controls, greenhouse sensors, rain barrels, orchard logs, and milking records streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, LoRaWAN, and Home Assistant.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=coop:egg
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eggs) as eggs by coop _time
| eventstats avg(eggs) as baseline_eggs by coop
| eval delta_eggs=eggs-baseline_eggs
description: Tracks daily egg totals against each coop's own baseline so drop-offs are easier to spot early.
value: Consistency often matters more than absolute output because it highlights stress, molting, or feed issues quickly.
implementation: Log daily egg counts per coop from a counter or simple mobile form and compare them with that coop's average.
visualization: Line chart of daily eggs and baseline delta by coop.
grandmaExplanation: It maps whether a coop's egg output is staying steady or suddenly dropping off.
